lines.text: The LORD stirred up David to take a census, and Joab questioned it, but the king's word prevailed.
Joab and the commanders crossed the Jordan and returned to Jerusalem after three months and ten days.
David's conscience was stricken, and through Gad he chose to fall into the LORD's hand rather than men's.
The plague killed seventy thousand people, and the angel of the LORD stood by the threshing floor of Araunah.
David bought the threshing floor and oxen for thirty shekels of silver, and there he built an altar.
